note:
A4 R2: Letzkus 2006 L2/3->L5 proximal vs distal in the OLD emodel (diagnostic; voltage is never a rule input).
(1) bAP amplitude vs path distance at L2/3->L5 apical synapses (out/vsyn_old.csv, letzkus_1ap_dt+10ms, peak V - rest in the
    pairing window = bAP + the small unitary EPSP) vs Letzkus et al. 2006 J Neurosci Fig 6D (single-AP dendritic patch):
    ~108 mV soma, 95-100 at 100 um, 75-85 at 200, 60-70 at 400, 55-65 at 500-600, ~47 at 700 um (read off by A5,
    a5_lit/ANCHORS.md Round 2 Q3 row 4). R1 cable toy apical curve shown too (params from figs/A4_R1_attenuation_data.json).
(2) Our proximal/distal pair label (pair_geometry letzkus_distal) vs Letzkus' split: median somatic 10-90 % rise time
    2.7 ms (Fig 1C), which Fig 1F (rise vs contact distance, ~80 um at 1.6 ms to ~950 um at 4.2 ms) puts at ~450 um.
    Table out/a4_letzkus_r2.csv, one row per L2/3->L5 pair.
(3) Distal-LTD condition in the A2 spine toy (a2_spine/spine_toy.py; scale factors kN/kV/kCa and bAP/EPSP template from
    a2_spine/toy_params.json when it exists, else mod values (k = 1) and a generic template: PROVISIONAL either way).
    Sweep the bAP amplitude A at the spine; one pairing (1 Hz pairing: c* carry-over exp(-1000/278) = 3 %, ignored).
    Self-consistent thresholds, as in the model: c_pre = peak c* of the pre spike alone, c_post(A) = peak c* of one bAP of
    amplitude A alone, theta_d = a00 c_pre + a01 c_post(A), theta_p = a10 c_pre + a11 c_post(A) (a, gamma from the B4/u97
    fit json). Cases: 1AP +10, 3AP@200 Hz +10, 3AP@200 Hz -10 (dt to the first AP). Per pairing: peak c*/theta_p,
    peak c*/theta_d, time above (run + free c* decay), net = gamma_p T_p - gamma_d (T_d - T_p) (sign = LTP vs LTD drive).
    Crossing amplitudes are mapped to distance with the emodel curve and with the Letzkus Fig 6D curve.
Data rows for reference (Letzkus 2006): 1AP +10 pooled 0.72 (Fig 2C-D, graded with distance); 3AP +10 proximal 1.3 /
distal 0.79 (Fig 4D); 3AP -10 proximal 0.89 / distal 1.42 (Fig 4H).
Out: figs/A4_R2_letzkus_bap.png + _data.json, out/a4_letzkus_r2.csv.   python letzkus_r2.py
